title: Sunset escrow fallback matrix and compatibility bridge for pinned model versions
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and implement a policy-driven 'sunset escrow' that provides deterministic, SLO-aware fallback behavior for customer-pinned model versions. The goal is to enable safe automated routing away from a pinned version when it becomes unavailable or is being retired while preserving behavioral compatibility and minimizing customer disruption. This ticket covers the policy schema, compatibility checks, routing execution, cache warming considerations, and rollout/rollback mechanics.
acceptance_criteria: Policy schema (YAML/JSON) defined that expresses ordered fallback tiers: regional variant, model-variant, quantized-compatible variant, and last-resort hosted fallback.
Compatibility bridge (runtime-level ABI and signature checks) that can be run as a preflight; rejects unsafe fallbacks with explicit reason codes.
Controller implements a sunset-escrow lifecycle: observe -> evaluate -> warm -> traffic-shift -> monitor -> finalize/rollback.
KV cache warmup path implemented for warmups during a fallback transition to avoid first-token latency spikes.
End-to-end integration test and canary pipeline added; CI job that simulates regional outage and validates rollback behavior.
Docs page and operator runbook created with Grafana dashboards and SLO alerts linked.
Feature gated behind 'sunset_escrow' and disabled by default for existing customers; opt-in via pin config until next major release.
technical_notes: Policy model: ordered list of fallback candidates with constraints: allowed_regions, latency_budget_ms, max_quality_drop_pct, and compatibility_signature.
Compatibility bridge: compute deterministic lightweight signature from model metadata + first-n logits distribution snapshot from the performance profile publishing pipeline.
Fallback decision engine will score candidates by weighted function: score = w1*compatibility_match + w2*(latency_budget - est_latency) + w3*(capacity_score) - penalty_if_requires_quantization.
Circuit-breaker guardrails: if 5xx rate > 0.5% or p95 latency > configured SLO for 3 minutes, automatically revert to previous pinned route and page on-call.
KV cache warmup uses historical recent KV prefixes (last 24h) sampled per-customer and replays to target instance within warmup window to reduce cold-token penalty.

Migration shim: when a fallback requires quantized variant, runtime inserts a 'compatibility shim' that normalizes tokenization differences and enriches structured output to include provenance headers for downstream traceability.
Telemetry: add 'fallback_reason', 'compatibility_score', 'warmup_success', and 'rollback_trigger' labels to request traces and billing logs for retrospective analysis.
rollout_plan: Week 1: Spec and policy schema PR to repo (RFC). Add unit tests for schema validation.
Week 2: Implement controller decision engine + scoring function behind feature flag in staging. Add compatibility bridge prototype and candidate scoring library.
Week 3: Integrate KV warmup path and add synthetic warmup dataset generator. Start internal QA canary tests with non-production tenants.
Week 4: Run closed canary for 3 customer teams, collect metrics, iterate on scoring weights. Add operator runbook and alert thresholds.
Gradual rollout: opt-in beta customers -> 5% traffic autopilot -> 25% -> full opt-in. Provide rollback button and automatic safety rollback based on SLOs.
qa_tests: Simulate regional outage: bring down 'us-west-2' zone and validate controller selects next eligible regional variant and warms caches within 45s.
Compatibility regression: introduce incompatible variant and assert controller refuses to route and emits clear reason code.
Latency SLO safety: artificially inflate p95 on fallback target and verify circuit-breaker prevents cutover and triggers fallback to prior route.
End-to-end perf: measure token latency and cost delta across fallback; ensure cost increase <= configured max_quality_drop_pct unless operator override.
Rollback path: force a failed warmup and ensure rollback happens automatically and a PagerDuty alert is created.
